note: Announced figures, not cash deployed. Multi-year commitments and staged investments are recorded at their headline amount. Coverage is limited to publicly disclosed terms.

funding.note: No product revenue at the time of the round
Split roughly evenly between equity and debt
ASML took the lead position — a supplier backing the model layer
Secondary sale valuation, not primary capital
Announced as up to $15B combined, staged
Reported; includes an SPV holding GPUs
Closed in the first week of January; exact date approximate
Announced at $730B pre-money: Amazon $50B, NVIDIA $30B, SoftBank $30B. Superseded by the March close.
Largest private financing on record; includes $3B from retail investors. Microsoft participated, size undisclosed.
Briefly the most valuable private company in the world; nearly triples the February valuation

deals.description: Multi-year investment paid substantially in Azure credits.
Early equity in a neocloud whose entire fleet is NVIDIA silicon; later extended by a capacity backstop.
GPU-backed term loan led by Blackstone and Magnetar — private credit underwriting hardware as collateral.
Cumulative investment paired with Trainium commitments and AWS as primary training partner.
Participation in Nebius’s raise to fund GPU purchases.
Stargate JV with Oracle and MGX. An announced four-year programme target, not committed capital — the headline figure exceeds all disclosed funding for it.
Capacity contract signed alongside a pre-IPO equity stake taken by OpenAI.
49% stake valuing Scale near $29B, with its leadership moving to Meta.
Lithography supplier taking the lead position in a model lab.
Five-year OCI capacity commitment; Oracle is funding the build largely with debt.
Up to $100B staged against 10GW of NVIDIA systems deployed by OpenAI — the supplier funding the customer that buys its chips.
Capacity contract running to 2031.
AMD issued OpenAI a warrant for up to 160M shares tied to 6GW of deployment — supplier equity granted against customer purchases.
10GW of co-designed custom accelerators.
Backstop of neocloud lease obligations in exchange for equity, enabling debt the operator could not otherwise raise.
Blue Owl funding the Hyperion campus through a JV that keeps the build off Meta’s balance sheet.
Up to 1GW of TPU capacity from an investor that is also the supplier.
Incremental Azure commitment alongside Microsoft’s ~27% stake — the investor is also the vendor being paid.
Seven-year AWS capacity agreement.
Microsoft and NVIDIA investing alongside a $30B Azure commitment from Anthropic.
Equity into an SPV holding GPUs for the Colossus cluster.
SpaceX acquired xAI at a $250B valuation, folding a frontier lab into a private space company. Exact date approximate.
NVIDIA’s tranche of OpenAI’s February round — the accelerator supplier funding its largest buyer.
Amazon’s tranche of the same round, alongside AWS capacity OpenAI buys.
SoftBank’s tranche; it went on to co-lead the March final close.
Expanded AWS partnership adding about 5GW of compute; Amazon is also an investor. Announced in April, exact date approximate.
Expanded infrastructure agreement running through December 2032. Announced in April, exact date approximate.
All-stock acquisition of Cursor’s parent announced days after SpaceX’s IPO; closed 14 August 2026.
AMD investing up to $5B alongside Anthropic deploying 2GW of Instinct MI450 — the same warrant-shaped structure AMD used with OpenAI in 2025.
Multiple gigawatts of next-generation TPU capacity with Google and Broadcom, coming online from 2027. Google is also an investor.
Roughly $45B of compute rented from Nscale over six years.

debt.description: GPU-backed delayed-draw term loan — the template for neocloud debt.
Perpetual preferred and project financing for HPC campuses.
Debt package funding the Colossus cluster.
Convertible notes funding GPU purchases against a Microsoft capacity contract.
Four-part offering ahead of the OpenAI capacity build.
SPV holding GPUs for Colossus 2, with NVIDIA participating.
Frontier campus financing, among the largest private data center packages raised.
Off-balance-sheet JV financing the Louisiana campus.
Largest US corporate bond sale since 2023, funding AI infrastructure.
Dual-currency issuance across US dollar and euro tranches.
First major issuance since 2022, funding AWS capacity.
First investment-grade-rated financing backed by GPUs — rating agencies accepting rapidly depreciating hardware as a credit category. Exact date approximate.
DDTL 5.0 delayed-draw term loan. Exact date approximate.
DDTL 5.5 facility, taking debt and equity raised year-to-date past $30B.
